description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: small snow-covered pine sapling, frozen bush with icicles, snow-capped grey boulder, cluster of pale blue ice crystals, smooth snowdrift mound, frosted tree stump, cracked patch of frozen lake ice, bush with red winter berries, fallen log half buried in snow, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
